properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.site-address: Land at Snow Hill; Melton Mowbray
properties.notes: Site been actively persued by landowner Worthearly Ltd, plans at an advanced stage of development. Formal pre app advice provided over 2018, inc design review and public consultation. May be issues with current tenant, relocation and impacts of noise from retained neighbouring industrial uses on new dwellings . May be issues in terms of developer ambitions to access Homes England funding to support their shared ownership product (HEYLO housing) and affordable housing contributions to MBC. also control parcel of land opposite allocation (staircase factory). Jeld Wen major local employer and development partially dependant on them moving site operations to suitable new premises locally.
